brandStory.title: Brand Story
brandStory.heading: BRAND STORY
brandStory.description: Discover the rebellious spirit and history of CREW Republic craft brewery in Munich.

drunkenSailor.title: Drunken Sailor IPA
drunkenSailor.heading: DRUNKEN SAILOR
drunkenSailor.subtitle: INDIA PALE ALE
drunkenSailor.description: Drunken Sailor IPA - Full-bodied, classic India Pale Ale brewed with passion by CREW Republic.

intro.title: Weigh the Anchor, Hoist the Sails...
intro.p1: Waves several meters high. Howling wind. That was daily life for the British sailors who shipped beer to India. To survive the months-long voyage, the beer needed plenty of hops and real strength.
intro.p2: Drunken Sailor IPA brings that adventure and bold flavor into the 21st century. Ahoy!

match.tasteText: Full-bodied & hoppy. Tropical fruit and citrus notes, intense yet well-rounded.
match.drinkWithText: The CREW enjoys Drunken Sailor with Thai cuisine as well as steaks and burgers!

jackpot.title: Jackpot Hazy IPA
jackpot.heading: JACKPOT
jackpot.subtitle: HAZY IPA
jackpot.description: Jackpot - Juicy and intensely aromatic Hazy IPA by CREW Republic.

intro.title: You're not a gambler, but sometimes you need that thrill.
intro.p1: All in. All or nothing. Your pulse races, everything around you blurs.
intro.p2: Then: silence. JACKPOT! Time to celebrate, and the best way to do it is with your crew.

match.tasteText: A tropical refreshment with an intense hop aroma of passion fruit and citrus fruits. Light-bodied with balanced acidity and subtle bitterness.
match.drinkWithText: The CREW prefers to enjoy their Jackpot Hazy IPA ice-cold to cool off in 35 degrees of blazing sun.

fireside.title: Fireside Red Ale
fireside.heading: FIRESIDE
fireside.subtitle: RED ALE
fireside.description: Fireside Red Ale - Rich, warming, and crafted for memorable moments around the bar or campfire by CREW Republic.

intro.title: An evening at the bar with old friends.
intro.p1: Stories from the past, memories of adventures we shared. A carefree time.
intro.p2: Like a long night by the campfire, accompanied by the soft crackling of the embers and the flickering light of the flames. May the evening never end...

tastometer.maltValue: Pilsner, melanoidin, caramel, and roasted malt

match.tasteText: Bright red in color with a pleasantly full-bodied yet not overly heavy texture. A slightly fruity and malty flavor.
match.drinkWithText: The CREW enjoys Fireside with a toasted turkey sandwich or a nice piece of mild cheddar cheese.

content.heading: Data Privacy
sections:
1) Introduction and Contact Details of the Controller
1.1 We are pleased that you are visiting our website and thank you for your interest. Below, we inform you about the handling of your personal data when using our website. Personal data is any data by which you can be personally identified.
1.2 The controller for data processing on this website within the meaning of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is CREW Republic Brewery GmbH, Andreas-Danzer-Weg 30, 85716 Unterschleißheim, Germany, Tel.: 089 411471290, Email: crew@crewrepublic.de.

2) Data Collection When Visiting Our Website
2.1 During the purely informative use of our website, we only collect data that your browser transmits to the site server (so-called "server log files"). These include: visited website, date and time of access, amount of data sent, source/referrer, browser type, operating system, and IP address (in anonymized form). Processing is carried out pursuant to Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR based on our legitimate interest in improving the stability and functionality of our website.
2.2 For security reasons and to protect the transmission of personal data and other confidential content, this website uses SSL/TLS encryption.

3) Cookies
In order to make visiting our website attractive and to enable the use of certain functions, we use cookies. Some cookies are deleted after closing the browser (session cookies), while others remain on your device (persistent cookies). Processing is carried out in accordance with Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR for contract performance, Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR with consent, or Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR for legitimate interests. You can configure your browser to inform you about the setting of cookies.

4) Contacting Us
When contacting us (e.g. via contact form or email), personal data is processed solely for the purpose of handling and responding to your request and only to the necessary extent pursuant to Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR or Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR.

5) Data Processing When Opening a Customer Account
Pursuant to Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR, personal data continues to be collected and processed to the extent required when opening a customer account. Deletion of your customer account is possible at any time by contacting the controller.

6) Use of Customer Data for Direct Advertising
6.1 Subscription to our email newsletter (Double Opt-In, Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). You may unsubscribe at any time via the link in the newsletter.
6.2 Newsletter dispatch to existing customers (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR in accordance with § 7(3) UWG).
6.3 Cart reminders via email (Double Opt-In, Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).

7) Data Processing for Order Processing
7.1 Forwarding to transport companies and credit institutions for contract fulfillment (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
7.2 Order processing via PlentyONE GmbH.
7.3 Forwarding to shipping service providers: DHL Paket GmbH, DPD Deutschland GmbH, United Parcel Service (UPS).
7.4 Payment service providers: Mollie B.V. for secure online payment processing.

8) Online Marketing
Google AdSense: Web advertising service by Google Ireland Limited. Uses cookies and web beacons. Processing only takes place with explicit consent pursuant to Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR.

9) Web Analytics Services
Google Analytics 4: Web analysis service by Google Ireland Limited with IP anonymization. Demographic features, Google Signals, and UserIDs are used with consent pursuant to Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR. Data is stored for two months.

10) Retargeting, Remarketing and Conversion Tracking
10.1 Meta Pixel with advanced matching (Meta Platforms Ireland Limited).
10.2 Google Ads Remarketing.
10.3 Google Ads Conversion Tracking and Customer Match.

11) Site Functionalities
11.1 Vimeo: Plugins for video playback.
11.2 Google Maps: Interactive map service for location display.
11.3 Google Web Fonts: Uniform display of fonts.

12) Rights of the Data Subject
12.1 Under GDPR, you have the right to access (Art. 15), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20), revocation of consent (Art. 7(3)), and right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (Art. 77).
12.2 RIGHT TO OBJECT: You have the right to object at any time to processing based on legitimate interests or for direct marketing purposes.

13) Duration of Storage of Personal Data
The storage period is determined based on the respective legal basis, processing purpose, and statutory retention periods. After retention periods expire, data is routinely erased.
